annotations.title: Payee check: is this payee a verified business before you pay?

description: Check a payee before paying it, by domain, paid endpoint URL or payout wallet: its verified record (company in official registers, EU VIES and LEI, OFAC, EU, UN and UK sanctions, wallets proven by signature), the wallet in a live quote compared with the proven ones, and pass, partial, review, unknown or block with reasons and a signed attestation. Never pays or signs. Use before the first payment to a seller. Example: domain=agent-data-tools.revmesh2074.workers.dev. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: Or: a payout wallet (0x); finds the domain that proved it by signature

domain.description: The payee's domain, e.g. shop.example.com (give domain, url or address)

url.description: Or: a paid endpoint; its domain's record is read and its quote's wallet compared
